title: Sindh Ministers Salaries Allowances and Privileges Amendment Act 2008

sections.shortTitle: Sindh Ministers Salaries Allowances and Privileges Amendment Act 2008
sections.description:
Short title and commencement

ACT XXX OF 2013
ACT XXX OF 2013
SINDH MINISTERS (SALARIES, ALLOWANCES AND
PRIVILEGES) (AMENDMENT) ACT, 2008
An Act to further amend the Sindh Ministers
(Salaries
Allowances and Privileges) Act, 1975
[Gazette of Sindh, Extraordinary, Part IV,
1st April, 2013]
No.PAS/Legis-B-10/2008,
dated 1-4-2013.---The Sindh Ministers (Salaries, Allowances and privileges)
(Amendment) Bill, 2008 having been passed by the provincial Assembly of Sindh
on 15th March, 2013 and assented to by the Governor of Sindh on 28th March,
2013 is hereby published as an Act of the Legislature of Sindh.
Preamble.---Whereas
it is expedient to further amend the Sindh Ministers (Salaries, Allowances and
Privileges) Act, 1975, in the manner hereinafter appearing;
It
is hereby enacted as follows:--
1. Short
title and commencement.---This Act may be called the Sindh Ministers
(Salaries, Allowances and Privileges) (Amendment) Act, 2008.
(2)
It shall come into force at once and shall be deemed to have taken effect on
and from 1st July, 2011.
